title: About this assistant
content: This is a bilingual (Bangla and English) AI assistant. It answers questions using the knowledge stored in this JSON file. Add more entries from the sidebar to teach it new things.

title: এই সহকারী সম্পর্কে
content: এটি একটি দ্বিভাষিক (বাংলা ও ইংরেজি) এআই সহকারী। এটি এই জেসন ফাইলে সংরক্ষিত তথ্যের ভিত্তিতে প্রশ্নের উত্তর দেয়। নতুন তথ্য যোগ করতে সাইডবার ব্যবহার করুন।

title: How to add data
content: Use the 'Knowledge Base' section in the sidebar to add a title and content. You can also upload a JSON file with a list of {title, content, tags} objects, or export the current data as JSON.

title: Gemini refinement
content: Paste a free Gemini API key in the sidebar (get one at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey) to let the assistant rewrite the retrieved answer into a more natural, fluent response in the language you asked in. Without a key, the assistant still answers using plain retrieval from the knowledge base.
